Check that the decision threshold matches the credible interval level

Source: R/config_validation.R
check_decision_threshold.Rd

Models sampled by MCMC reject the null when the central credible interval at confidence_level excludes it, and stop on any other threshold. The other models reject it when the posterior probability of benefit exceeds critical_value, and report the interval separately. The two rules agree only when critical_value is (1 + confidence_level) / 2. Any other pair would make some methods report intervals that contradict their decisions, and would stop the MCMC methods partway through a run, so it is refused up front.

Usage

check_decision_threshold(config, context)

Arguments

config

The simulation configuration.

context

The name of the configuration, used in the error.

Value

No return value, called for side effects.
